payload.summary: Requested by Jim (in chat, 2026-07-28): the version string lives in two unlinked places — package.json "version" and VERSION in src/cli.ts — and they can drift (Phase 2 shipped without a bump partly because of this). Make package.json the single source of truth: src/cli.ts should read/import the version from package.json so the merge ritual bumps exactly one place. Keep the semver-shape test in tests/cli.test.ts.
